facts.statement: The Stampede community event sent players with a Ride or pet from Durango Zoo to the Seaside beach, on Server 1.
facts.quote: stampede them from the zoo to the Seaside beach

facts.statement: The Stampede event ran Thursday April 1, 2010 at 3pm Pacific Time for U.S. and Latin America on Server 1.
facts.quote: Thursday April 1st, 2010 3pm Pacific Time (U.S. and Latin America) Server 1

facts.statement: For UK and Europe the Stampede started at 9:00am Pacific Time / 4:00pm GMT on Server 1.
facts.quote: 9:00am Pacific Time / 4:00pm GMT (UK and Europe) Server 1

article_summaries.title: Community Event: Stampede!
article_summaries.summary: A community event page announcing the Stampede, where players with a Ride or pet run animals from Durango Zoo to the Seaside beach on April 1, 2010 (Server 1, with separate US/Latin America and UK/Europe times). The page gives the event schedule and explains how to find community events via the Game Guide calendar and GO button.
